usedFor: Google Forms collects the answers and Google Sheets is where you read and sort them. Each “New Form Response” in Google Forms can run “Add New Row to Sheet”, so every submission becomes a row in the sheet you work from.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Response” in Google Forms, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each response is a record, and a new row keeps the answers in order. “Add New Row to Sheet” maps by header or by direct column letter.

watchOut: “New Form Response” is polling, so rows appear after a scheduled check. “Update Spreadsheet Row” changes an existing row, so for new submissions use “Add New Row to Sheet”.
